# Oral-B

> > Oral-B is a leading oral care brand offering smart electric toothbrushes, replacement heads, water flossers, dental floss, and personalized oral health solutions powered by AI brushing recognition and mobile connectivity.

Oral-B specializes in innovative dental care products spanning electric toothbrushes (iO series with Bluetooth connectivity), manual toothbrushes, water flossers, and complementary oral care products. The site features interactive tools for product discovery, comparison, and personalized recommendations, alongside deals, gift guides, and customer support resources.

## Key Topics

- iO Series Electric Toothbrushes
- Smart Modes & A.I. Brushing Recognition
- Bluetooth Connectivity
- Oral-B app
- Water Flosser Advanced
- Replacement Brush Heads
- iO Sense Smart Magnetic Charger
- Gum Care & Whitening
- Kids' Electric Toothbrushes
- Product Comparison Tools
- ADA-Approved Products
- Clic Manual Toothbrush
- Crest Whitening Integration
- P&G Rewards Program
- Personalized Brush Finder

## Electric Toothbrushes

- [Our best electric toothbrushes | Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/electric-toothbrushes): Main product page for iO electric toothbrush series with smart features, Bluetooth connectivity, and A.I. brushing recognition.
- [Our best electric toothbrushes | Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/compare/electric-toothbrushes): Side-by-side comparison tool for iO series electric toothbrushes to help customers find the right model.
- [Compare Our Best Multi-Series Electric Toothbrushes | Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/compare/non-iO-electric-toothbrushes): Comparison tool for Genius, Smart, and Pro series toothbrushes across multiple features and price points.
- [Electric Toothbrushes - Twin Packs and Bundles - Page 1 - Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/electric-toothbrushes/twin-packs-and-bundles): Bundle deals including Oral-B and Crest whitening and gum care sets for families and couples.
- [KIDS' ELECTRIC TOOTHBRUSHES | Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/kids): Kids' electric toothbrushes with Disney Magic Timer and cavity prevention features for children.

## Oral Care Products & Accessories

- [More Products - Water Flosser - Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/more-products/water-flosser): Oral-B Water Flosser Advanced with Oxyjet Technology for superior gum health and interdental cleaning.
- [Dental Floss, Dental Tape and Floss Picks | Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/compare/floss): Dental floss product comparison including Glide, Super Floss, and picks for different cleaning preferences.
- [Mouthwash & Premium Oral Rinse | Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/compare/rinse): Comparison of specialty mouthwash products for gum care and dry mouth treatment.
- [More Products - Manual Toothbrushes - Oral-B](https://oralb.com/en-us/products/toothbrushes/manual-toothbrushes): Manual toothbrush collection including Clic and ADA-approved options for traditional brushing.
- [Clic Manual Toothbrush by Oral-B](https://oralb.com/shop/clic-toothbrush): Oral-B Clic manual toothbrush with replaceable heads and eco-friendly sustainable design.
